message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for this case. Facts: Zhu1 started meat chicken processing, built factories, then from 2003 onward, without government/financial approval, used high interest rates and factories as guarantee to attract public funds from 2712 people, total 54,914.7497万元 (~549 million RMB). Paid interest 13,947.67696 million, actual loss 40,967.07274 million. Funds used for interest payments and personal consumption, not for production. The factories' assets only 2,506.57 million. So this is illegal fundraising, i.e., "非法吸收公众存款" (illegal public deposit collection) or "非法集资". In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "非法吸收公众存款罪". The description: using high interest, no approval, to the public, large amount. So the correct charge is "非法吸收公众存款". The earlier examples show that for similar facts they used "非法吸收公众存款". For example, the first example with similar facts (徐某甲) they corrected to "非法吸收公众存款". So answer: [罪名]非法吸收公众存款<eoa>. No other charges? Possibly also "诈骗罪"? But the prosecution says "使用诈骗方法非法集资". However the correct classification is illegal public deposit collection, not fraud. In Chinese law, illegal fundraising is separate from fraud. The correct label is "非法吸收公众存款". So single charge.
